name: ts_import_export_mismatch
prompt:
Fix the TypeScript import/export mismatch.

Requirements:
- Modify slug.ts only.
- slug.ts must provide the named export makeSlug used by main.ts.
- makeSlug must lowercase text, trim surrounding whitespace, collapse whitespace groups to hyphens, and remove non-alphanumeric hyphen characters.
- Do not modify main.ts.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only the function export changes.
- Use patch_plan if export wiring in slug.ts must change.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: node --experimental-strip-types main.ts
